properties.name: Target Type
properties.description: Required exact target family: Server, UCS-X Chassis, or Domain. A Domain upgrade covers both Fabric Interconnects; individual FI selection is not supported.

properties.name: Device Organization
properties.description: Exact Cisco Intersight organization used by the atomic to resolve the firmware target.

properties.name: Target Name
properties.description: Exact organization-scoped server, UCS-X chassis, or Domain name. The atomic validates identity and cardinality.

properties.name: Firmware Version
properties.description: Exact Cisco Repository firmware catalog version. No production version is prepopulated.

properties.name: Server Upgrade Mode
properties.description: Server-only mode: Start Immediately or Mount Only. Keep Start Immediately for chassis and Domain targets.

properties.name: Enable Fabric Evacuation
properties.description: Domain switch-upgrade option. Keep true for server and UCS-X chassis targets.

properties.name: Enable PSU Upgrade
properties.description: Domain switch-upgrade option. Keep false for server and UCS-X chassis targets.

properties.name: Enable PDB FPGA Upgrade
properties.description: Domain switch-upgrade option. Keep false for server and UCS-X chassis targets.

properties.name: Skip Wait for I/O Connectivity
properties.description: Domain option mapped by the atomic to SkipWaitForIoPathConnectivity. Keep false for server and chassis targets.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: HTTP-style outcome. 202 means a new asynchronous upgrade was accepted. 200 means immediate completion, already-installed firmware, or an existing upgrade was handled without a new submission. Result.status distinguishes these outcomes. 4xx/5xx values indicate rejection, inspection required, or failure.

properties.name: Status Message
properties.description: Human-readable outcome distinguishing a validated accepted submission from immediate completion or failure.

properties.name: Error Message
properties.description: Actionable submission failure detail. Empty when a concrete accepted or immediately completed resource was validated.

properties.name: Result
properties.description: Upgrade outcome, target and image, available tracking IDs, and any inventory or submission uncertainty. already-installed means no submission was needed. already-in-progress can be found before submission or by the follow-up lookup; submissionAttempted distinguishes these cases.

properties.description: Firmware UpgradeStatus Moid, when available. The Upgrade ID and Upgrade Resource Type identify the operation when this is empty.

Starts a Cisco Repository firmware upgrade for one Server, UCS-X Chassis or IMM Domain. Supply Target Type, Device Organization, Target Name and Firmware Version; only options for the chosen target apply. Validates the target and image, skips verified installed firmware, returns IDs for an active upgrade, or submits once. Returns tracking IDs, Result and actionable messages on the selected Intersight endpoint. A 202 result means the request was accepted; monitor progress in Intersight.
Starts the firmware upgrade exactly once and classifies the returned submission contract without monitoring completion.

Invokes the existing atomic exactly once. The atomic validates inputs, target, image, duplicate-upgrade state, readiness, request shape, and the concrete create response. It returns immediately after a valid Intersight resource is accepted and never polls for completion.
Checks the returned result and tracking IDs. Distinguishes a new request, installed firmware, an active upgrade and failure without submitting again.

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
activitySucceeded = sys.argv[9] == 'true'
atomicStatusCode = sys.argv[10]
atomicStatusMessage = sys.argv[11]
atomicErrorMessage = sys.argv[12]
atomicResultRaw = sys.argv[13]
firmwareVersion = sys.argv[6]
deviceOrganization = sys.argv[7]
requestedTargetName = sys.argv[8]
result = None
try:
    candidate = json.loads(atomicResultRaw) if atomicResultRaw else None
    if isinstance(candidate, dict):
        result = candidate
except Exception:
    result = None
outcome = 'failure'
outputStatusCode = '502'
outputStatusMessage = 'Firmware upgrade atomic failed or returned an unusable contract'
outputErrorMessage = 'The firmware upgrade atomic did not return a usable submission contract. Inspect the atomic execution before retrying; this wrapper never resubmits.'
requestAccepted = isinstance(result, dict) and result.get('requestAccepted') is True
completed = isinstance(result, dict) and result.get('completed') is True
atomicState = str(result.get('status') or '') if isinstance(result, dict) else ''
identityReady = isinstance(result, dict) and all((isinstance(result.get(key), str) and bool(result.get(key)) for key in ('targetType', 'targetMoid', 'imageMoid', 'createdMoid')))
if activitySucceeded and result is not None and requestAccepted and identityReady and completed and (atomicState == 'completed') and (atomicStatusCode == '200'):
    outcome = 'completed'
    outputStatusCode = '200'
    outputStatusMessage = atomicStatusMessage or 'Firmware upgrade completed immediately'
    outputErrorMessage = ''
elif activitySucceeded and result is not None and requestAccepted and identityReady and (not completed) and (atomicState == 'accepted') and (atomicStatusCode == '202'):
    outcome = 'accepted'
    outputStatusCode = '202'
    outputStatusMessage = atomicStatusMessage or 'Firmware upgrade resource accepted; completion is not monitored'
    outputErrorMessage = ''
elif activitySucceeded and result is not None and atomicStatusCode == '200' and result.get('requestAccepted') is False and result.get('newRequestSubmitted') is False and result.get('noOp') is True and result.get('status') in ('already-installed', 'already-in-progress'):
    installed = result.get('status') == 'already-installed' and result.get('completed') is True and result.get('installedStateVerified') is True
    existing = result.get('status') == 'already-in-progress' and result.get('completed') is False and result.get('resourceReused') is True and identityReady
    if installed or existing:
        outcome = result['status']
        outputStatusCode = '200'
        outputStatusMessage = atomicStatusMessage or result.get('message') or 'No new firmware request was submitted'
        outputErrorMessage = ''
elif activitySucceeded and result is not None and atomicStatusCode == '200' and result.get('status') == 'already-in-progress' and result.get('submissionReconciled') is True and result.get('submissionAttempted') is True and result.get('newRequestSubmitted') is True and result.get('noOp') is False and result.get('completed') is False and result.get('resourceReused') is True and identityReady:
    outcome = 'already-in-progress'
    outputStatusCode = '200'
    outputStatusMessage = atomicStatusMessage or result.get('message') or 'An active firmware upgrade was found after submission'
    outputErrorMessage = ''
elif result is not None:
    outputStatusCode = atomicStatusCode if re.fullmatch('[45][0-9][0-9]', atomicStatusCode) is not None else '502'
    outputStatusMessage = atomicStatusMessage or 'Firmware upgrade atomic reported failure'
    outputErrorMessage = atomicErrorMessage or atomicStatusMessage or 'The firmware upgrade atomic reported failure without an error message. Inspect its Result before retrying.'
if isinstance(result, dict):
    result['deviceOrganization'] = deviceOrganization
    result['requestedTargetName'] = requestedTargetName
    result['requestedFirmwareVersion'] = firmwareVersion
    result['wrapperDisposition'] = outcome
    result['wrapperStatusCode'] = outputStatusCode
    result['atomicStatusCode'] = atomicStatusCode or None
    result['atomicActivitySucceeded'] = activitySucceeded
    result['atomicStatusMessage'] = atomicStatusMessage or None
    result['atomicErrorMessage'] = atomicErrorMessage or None
    result['resourceIdentifiersAvailable'] = identityReady
    if atomicErrorMessage:
        result['atomicWarning'] = atomicErrorMessage
    outputResultJson = json.dumps(result, separators=(',', ':'))
else:
    outputResultJson = json.dumps({'status': 'failed', 'requestAccepted': False, 'atomicActivitySucceeded': activitySucceeded, 'atomicStatusCode': atomicStatusCode or None, 'atomicStatusMessage': atomicStatusMessage or None, 'atomicErrorMessage': atomicErrorMessage or None, 'deviceOrganization': deviceOrganization, 'requestedTargetName': requestedTargetName, 'requestedFirmwareVersion': firmwareVersion, 'wrapperDisposition': outcome, 'wrapperStatusCode': outputStatusCode, 'atomicResultRaw': atomicResultRaw or None, 'retryRequiresInspection': True}, separators=(',', ':'))
helperReady = outcome in ('failure', 'accepted', 'completed', 'already-installed', 'already-in-progress') and re.fullmatch('[1-5][0-9][0-9]', outputStatusCode) is not None and bool(outputStatusMessage and outputResultJson) and (outcome == 'failure' and bool(outputErrorMessage) or (outcome in ('accepted', 'completed', 'already-installed', 'already-in-progress') and outputErrorMessage == ''))

createdMoid, createdResourceType, upgradeStatusMoid = sys.argv[14:17]
if not isinstance(createdMoid, str) or re.fullmatch('[0-9a-fA-F]{24}', createdMoid) is None or createdResourceType not in ('firmware.Upgrade', 'firmware.ChassisUpgrade', 'firmware.SwitchUpgrade'):
    createdMoid = createdResourceType = ''
if not createdMoid or not isinstance(upgradeStatusMoid, str) or re.fullmatch('[0-9a-fA-F]{24}', upgradeStatusMoid) is None:
    upgradeStatusMoid = ''
